brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Storage box (enclosed container with walls and bottom)
requirements.evidence: 2-storey box: level 0 bases (piece:0,0,0 etc) as floor, level 1 ring of bases with open caps sealing sides, bottom closed. Creates storage volume.

Four top covers cover:-1,0,1;full;top etc form lid/deck across top. Covers include integrated magnets by default (setCoverMagnets already true - REFUSED ALREADY_FITTED). Magnets hold lid to base magnets.

finish.summary: Built a compact 2-high hexagonal storage box with four interlocking base cells capped on sides, and a four-cover lid on top level. Top covers have integrated magnets (default fitted) to hold lid shut to the base.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

result.note: A cover goes on an open top or side face of a base. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
